verdict.rationale: Guidance and front-page text from both unternehmensregister.de and handelsregister.de was captured as readable static content, including search labels, register descriptions, the Bilanz-Navigator and LEI guidance. The llms.txt probe got a plain HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page, which suggests the server answers an agent directly. However, no probe explicitly records the user agent used, the absence of a CAPTCHA or bot wall, or whether deeper guidance pages render without JavaScript, and the front page itself reports overload-driven unavailability. Missing for 10: an explicit probe showing 200 responses with an identified user agent and no challenge, coverage of deeper guidance and help pages beyond the homepages, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: Der Bilanz-Navigator hilft Ihnen bei der Frage, wie und wo Sie Ihre Rechnungslegungsunterlagen und Unternehmensberichte offenlegen müssen.
Auf dieser Seite finden Sie die Handels-, Genossenschafts- , Partnerschafts-, Gesellschaftsregister sowie die Vereinsregister aller Bundesländer und darüber hinaus die Registerbekanntmachungen
